# Configuration keys

Source: `config/harness-knobs.json`.

## Host lane settings

Set these in `[domains.lanes]` in the host configuration. Omit a key for its default.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `user_skills` | discover | Discover host user skills for lanes read-only. off disables host user skill discovery unless overridden by domains.lanes.projects.{project_id}.user_skills or route policy lane.user_skills. Route policy wins over project, then host. Inspect value, default and origin with config show or config schema. (discover or off). |
| `skill_stage_max_bytes` | 16777216 | Maximum bytes copied into an attempt's read-only user skill tree. Content exceeding the bound is skipped with a warning. Inspect value and origin with config show. (bytes, 0 or more). |
| `projects.{project}.shared_paths` | [] | Existing paths shared read-write with this project's writers. Absolute, ~/ and primary-checkout-relative paths are accepted. Git, credential, protected and executable paths are omitted with a warning. Read-only lanes receive no additional writes. (existing absolute, ~/ or checkout-relative paths). |
| `projects.{project}.exec_roots` | [] | Read-and-execute directory subtrees relative to the primary checkout. Entries escaping that checkout, missing, protected, credential or writable targets are ignored with a warning naming the configuration key. (directory paths relative to the primary checkout). |

## Host lane build settings

Set these in `[domains.fabric.lanes]` in the host configuration. Omit a key for its host-dependent default; -1 also selects automatic behaviour.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `memory_pressure_threshold` | critical | Kernel memory pressure level at which new lanes wait on macOS. warning also defers at critical; never disables the pressure gate. The memory and disk floors still apply. (critical, warning or never). |
| `max_concurrent_builds` | max(1, min(cores / cargo_build_jobs, GiB of RAM / 6)) | A build throttle, not a hard cap: cargo builds, tests, checks and lints that a lane's cargo shim runs at once across the host and every project that shares the state directory. Lanes are not capped by it; a command that compiles waits for a free slot. Direct ~/.cargo/bin/cargo, rustc and non-cargo builds are not gated. (1 to 64 or -1 for auto). |
| `build_wait_minutes` | 30 | Minutes a build waits for a build slot or another build's Cargo lock before it gives up with an error. (1 to 1440 or -1 for auto). |
| `lane_port_base` | 30000 | First port of the range split into per-writer-lane blocks. Each writer lane holds one block for its lifetime and sees it as PROVENANT_LANE_PORT_BASE and PROVENANT_LANE_PORT_COUNT. (1024 to 65535 or -1 for auto). |
| `lane_port_block` | 16 | Ports in each writer lane's block (PROVENANT_LANE_PORT_COUNT). (1 to 1024 or -1 for auto). |
| `lane_port_blocks` | 64 | Blocks in the range, so the most writer lanes that hold a block at once; the base plus blocks times block size must be at most 65536. 0 turns allocation off. A writer launched while every block is held is not started and reports no free port block. (0 to 1024 or -1 for auto). |
| `max_writer_lanes` | 40 | Most writer lanes live at once across the host; a writer beyond it queues and is then refused with a reason naming the cap. (1 to 64 or -1 for auto). |
| `max_project_writer_lanes` | 30 | Most writer lanes live at once for one project; at most max_writer_lanes. (1 to 32 or -1 for auto). |
| `cargo_build_jobs` | Half the available cores, at least 1 | Default CARGO_BUILD_JOBS for lanes; an inherited value takes precedence. (1 to 1024 or -1 for auto). |
| `cargo_incremental` | false | CARGO_INCREMENTAL for lanes. Incremental sessions grow a lane's target without bound and are rarely reused; a value already in the lane environment takes precedence. (true or false). |
| `cargo_debug` | line-tables-only | CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG for lanes. Line tables keep backtraces at a fraction of the size of full debug information; a value already in the lane environment takes precedence. (none, line-directives-only, line-tables-only, limited, full, 0, 1, 2, true or false). |
| `build_dir_max_bytes` | 21474836480 (20 GiB) | Cap on the allocated bytes of all Cargo profile directories in lane caches, idle and busy alike. Collection removes idle directories, least recently used first, after a lane settles, when admission finds the disk below gc.free_floor, and in `provenant gc`; a directory whose Cargo locks are held is never removed. When busy directories alone exceed the cap, every eligible idle directory is removed and the total stays over. (bytes, 0 or more). |
| `build_dir_grace_seconds` | 900 (15 minutes) | A profile directory whose newest file or directory modification is within this many seconds is never removed, even when its Cargo locks are free: test and run binaries execute after Cargo drops its locks, and Cargo may be opening its lock files. Zero removes the protection. It protects only recently written directories: a test or run binary that runs longer than the grace without writing under target/ is unprotected unless a Cargo lock is still held. (seconds, 0 or more). |
| `build_dir_survey_interval_seconds` | 300 (5 minutes) | Settlement-triggered collection walks the lane caches at most this often, unless free space is below gc.free_floor or the last walk found the total within 10% of the cap. While free space stays below the floor, every settlement walks. Zero walks on every settlement. (seconds, 0 or more). |

## Host graph settings

Set these in `[domains.fabric.graph]` in the host configuration. Omit a key for its default.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `ci_poll_backoff.initial_seconds` | 0 | Initial delay after a pending CI observation. Each later observation doubles the delay up to max_seconds; the remaining CI timeout takes precedence. Zero makes the gate eligible at the next tick. (seconds, 0 or more). |
| `ci_poll_backoff.max_seconds` | 0 | Maximum per-gate polling delay. The 60-second scheduler interval determines the earliest automatic re-check. (seconds, 0 or more). |
| `ci_poll_overrides.<node_id>` | empty | Override the host CI polling policy for one node ID. Values and origins appear in config show. (initial_seconds and max_seconds). |
| `allowed_read_roots` | empty (read roots stay inside the project and its registered worktrees) | Absolute host directories that graph and preset `read_roots` may name besides the project's own registered worktrees. (absolute directory paths). |
| `limits.expansion_depth` | 64 | Longest dependency chain in edges, root nodes at depth 0, and deepest composite nesting a graph may expand to. The bundled `big-batch` preset needs 33. Graph documents cannot raise it. (1 or more). |
| `limits.continuations` | 2 | Graph continuations limit. (0 or more). |
| `limits.nodes` | 512 | Graph nodes limit. (1 or more). |
| `limits.edges` | 4096 | Graph edges limit. (1 or more). |
| `limits.routes_per_node` | 16 | Graph routes per node limit. (1 or more). |
| `limits.review_substitutions` | 1 | Maximum substitutions per review member. (0 or more). |
| `limits.node_prompt_bytes` | 262144 | Graph node prompt bytes limit. (1 or more). |
| `limits.graph_prompt_bytes` | 4194304 | Graph graph prompt bytes limit. (1 or more). |
| `limits.fan_out_width` | 32 | Graph fan out width limit. (1 or more). |
| `limits.concurrency` | 0 | Graph concurrency limit. Zero uses host lane caps. (0 or more). |

## Host store settings

Set these in `[domains.fabric.limits]` in the host configuration. Omit a key for its default.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `store_busy_timeout_ms` | 30000 (30 seconds) | Milliseconds a command waits for a contended local store, both the SQLite busy timeout and the stores' own advisory locks, before it reports contention. Read once when a command starts; zero fails fast (0 to 600000). |

## Host review lens settings

Set these in `[domains.routing.review.lenses.by_paths]` in the host configuration. Omit the table for the bundled rules.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `"<glob>".add` | bundled test-path rules (`**/tests/**`, `**/*.test.*`, `**/conftest.py` and others) add `tests` | Add these review lenses, outside the slot cap and once, when a changed path matches the glob. The reason is recorded as `by_paths:<glob>` in `--explain` and the review report. Setting any `by_paths` table replaces the bundled rules; an empty `[domains.routing.review.lenses.by_paths]` removes them. (lens names, such as tests). |

## Host model policy settings

Set these in `[domains.routing.model_policy]` in the host configuration. Omit a key for its bundled or empty default. `rules.policy` takes the same fields as `defaults`.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `bundled` | true | Start from the bundled per-model policy (cache prices, compaction windows, lane guidance, result checks). false starts empty. (true or false). |
| `defaults.cache.read_share_target` | unset (bundled 0.9) | Advisory cache-read share a lane should reach; reported in stats, never enforced. (0 to 1). |
| `defaults.cache.price_multiplier` | 1.0 (bundled: 2.0 in DeepSeek weekday peak) | Current price multiplier; divides the read-heavy preference weight. (number above 0). |
| `defaults.cache.read_ratio` | per model | Cache-read price divided by uncached input price. (0 or more). |
| `defaults.cache.write_ratio` | per model | Cache-write price divided by uncached input price. (0 or more). |
| `defaults.cache.output_ratio` | per model | Output price divided by uncached input price, for compaction break-even guidance. (0 or more). |
| `defaults.cache.ttl_seconds` | unset | Provider cache time to live. (seconds, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.cache.min_prefix` | unset | Smallest prefix the provider caches. (tokens, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.cache.context_window` | per model | Context window size; read-heavy preference needs at least 1000000. (tokens, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.cache.read_heavy_weight` | 3 | Weight multiplier for read-heavy and review work on cheap-cache models. (1 to 255). |
| `defaults.compaction.window` | per model | Context size at which compaction is advised. (tokens, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.compaction.mode` | per model | When compaction is advised. (auto, task_boundary or never). |
| `defaults.compaction.min_turns` | per model | Fewest turns before compaction is advised. (turns, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.lane.max_context` | unset | Enforced largest context for a lane on this model. (tokens, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.lane.max_turns` | unset | Enforced most turns for a lane on this model. (turns, 1 or more). |
| `defaults.lane.stop_early_ok` | per model | false marks a model prone to stopping early; an unfinished result then gets a bounded continuation. (true or false). |
| `defaults.lane.max_continuations` | 2 where stop_early_ok is false | Most continuations after an unfinished result. (0 to 255). |
| `defaults.lane.user_skills` | inherit domains.lanes.user_skills | Override host and project user skill discovery for matching routes. rules.policy.lane.user_skills uses the same values. (discover or off). |
| `defaults.lane.read_only` | per model | true refuses write lanes on this model. (true or false). |
| `defaults.result.check` | per model | Check the result for the required sections before accepting it. (true or false). |
| `defaults.result.sections` | per model | Heading lines a result must contain. (exact section heading lines; empty clears). |
| `defaults.result.fallback` | per model | Model for the one fallback attempt when the result check fails. (model id). |
| `defaults.result.fallback_effort` | per model | Effort for the fallback attempt. (effort name). |
| `rules` | empty | Layered overrides ordered by scope: global, adapter, model, account, model plus account; later rules win at equal scope. Schedule start is inclusive, expiry and window end are exclusive; an overnight window wraps midnight; inactive rules have no effect. (tables with adapter, model, account, schedule {starts, expires as RFC 3339 timestamps, windows [{weekdays?, start_hour, end_hour}] in UTC} and policy (the same fields as defaults, under rules.policy); weekdays use Monday-based indexes, Monday 0 through Sunday 6). |

## Quota history and plan prices

Set the cap in `[domains.quota]`; set prices per account as shown.

| Key | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `history_max_bytes` | 4194304 (4 MiB) | Disk cap for each account's quota history under quota/history/. Readings go to a current file that rotates to one predecessor at half the cap, so the pair never exceeds it and the newest reading is always kept. (65536 to 134217728 bytes). |

### Account plan prices

```json
{
  "effect": "Prices over time for the account. The entry with the latest effective_from on or before a reading applies to it, and quota history --json shows it as plan_price, with price and notional_usd. Dates must differ within an account; unknown keys, negative or non-finite prices and bad dates refuse the config. This is not the detected plan label, which comes from the provider or the account's plan option.",
  "fields": {
    "currency": "Three capital letters (ISO 4217). USD when omitted. No conversion is applied.",
    "effective_from": "First day the price applies, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).",
    "name": "Plan label, for example max_5x. At most 64 characters.",
    "notional_usd": "Optional list-price value in USD of a free or discounted plan, for example 20 for a student plan priced 0.",
    "price": "Price per month in currency; 0 or more, 0 for a free plan."
  },
  "form": "array of tables, any number of entries",
  "path": "domains.accounts.entries.<id>.plans"
}
```

## Provider updates

```json
{
  "path": "providers.<id>",
  "provider_ids": [
    "claude",
    "codex",
    "cursor",
    "agy",
    "opencode"
  ],
  "runtime_deadline_seconds": {
    "default": "unset",
    "effect": "Cap on the wall-clock runtime of any lane on this provider. A dispatch's own --provider-timeout applies when it is shorter. At the deadline the provider is stopped and the attempt settles as timed_out, whatever the host did meanwhile, including sleeping.",
    "max": 14400,
    "min": 1,
    "type": "int"
  },
  "update": {
    "default": true,
    "effect": "Run the detected native updater in a detached one-shot worker scheduled by quota events. Provider preparation briefly shares the update lock; running lanes do not hold it. If all candidates are updating, dispatch waits at most --wait (capped at 30 seconds), then uses the installed version. false opts out; {command: [program, argument, ...]} overrides the updater directly without a shell.",
    "type": "bool_or_command_argv"
  },
  "update_interval_seconds": {
    "default": 86400,
    "effect": "Minimum time between update attempts, checked on existing housekeeping events. Failed and interrupted attempts and result-write errors wait the same interval.",
    "min": 1,
    "type": "int"
  },
  "update_timeout_seconds": {
    "default": 300,
    "effect": "Maximum native updater duration in the detached worker. Timeout kills the updater process group and records failure. Updater descendants retain the exclusive lease until exit, including descendants that leave the group.",
    "min": 1,
    "type": "int"
  }
}
```

| `default` | `[]` |
| `effect` | `"Ordered registered Claude account labels allowed as switch targets; empty allows none."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/src/chair.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"An explicit list controls which signed-in accounts may receive the chair."` |
| `type` | `"string_list"` |

## `chair.switch_threshold`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `92` |
| `effect` | `"Switch when either the five-hour or weekly cached Claude usage reaches this percentage."` |
| `max` | `100` |
| `min` | `1` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/src/chair.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"Lower switches sooner; higher leaves less headroom for the handoff."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `config.history_max_age_days`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `365` |
| `effect` | `"Drop configuration history entries older than this many days."` |
| `max` | `3650` |
| `min` | `1` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/config/src/history.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"A longer window keeps older changes visible but grows the history file."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `config.history_max_bytes`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `262144` |
| `effect` | `"Keep the configuration history file under this many bytes; the oldest entries are dropped first."` |
| `max` | `16777216` |
| `min` | `4096` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/config/src/history.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"A larger bound keeps more history but costs more to read on every config edit."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `config.history_max_entries`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `500` |
| `effect` | `"Keep at most this many entries in the configuration history; the oldest are dropped first."` |
| `max` | `100000` |
| `min` | `10` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/config/src/history.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"A higher count keeps a longer audit trail but a larger history file."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `confinement.census_exclude_ancestors`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `true` |
| `effect` | `"Exclude the invoking process's ancestor chain from live-writer detection at run admission. When false, only the invoking process itself is excluded, so an ancestor shell with its working directory inside the worktree is treated as a live writer."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/confinement/src/worktrees/census.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `type` | `"bool"` |

## `confinement.census_ignore_unreadable`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `[]` |
| `effect` | `"Host-owned exact executable path and signing team_id (or platform) exceptions for actual cwd EPERM. All real/effective/saved uids must be system accounts foreign to every root owner; platform entries also require a root-owned chain with no group/other write permission. Listed executables may occupy a worktree. Invalid/unreadable signing state never qualifies. Not accepted through dispatch --knob or Fabric overrides."` |
| `host_only` | `true` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `type` | `"census_ignore_list"` |

## `fabric.accept_handoff`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `false` |
| `effect` | `"Let a Fabric peer start a Claude session on this host through a session hand-off."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/src/handoff.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Off refuses every hand-off with HANDOFF_DISABLED; on lets a peer open an unconfined session under a registered account."` |
| `type` | `"bool"` |

## `lanes.max_concurrency`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `8` |
| `effect` | `"Default number of lanes one batch runs at once when any lane in it writes a worktree, resolved from the profile. An explicit dispatch concurrency wins."` |
| `max` | `8` |
| `min` | `1` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/run.rs, tools/front-door/crates/run/src/launch.rs, tools/front-door/crates/run/src/admission.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"Lower paces quota and memory and lengthens wall time; total tokens are unchanged."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `lanes.max_concurrency_read_only`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `16` |
| `effect` | `"Default number of lanes one batch runs at once when no lane in it writes a worktree, resolved from the profile. A lanes.max_concurrency you set yourself also caps it unless you set this knob too. An explicit dispatch concurrency wins."` |
| `max` | `16` |
| `min` | `1` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/run.rs, tools/front-door/crates/run/src/launch.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"Lower paces quota and memory and lengthens wall time; total tokens are unchanged. Read-only lanes start 2 s apart whatever this value."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `lanes.max_depth`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `2` |
| `effect` | `"Maximum nested lane depth, including the first dispatched lane."` |
| `min` | `1` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Lower limits delegation chains; higher permits deeper nested work."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `lanes.prepare_deps`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `true` |
| `effect` | `"Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile on the host for a writer worktree with a pnpm lockfile and no completed install (node_modules/.modules.yaml), after head and route checks and before the provider starts."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/run/provider/preparation.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"false skips automatic dependency installation; the writer may then lack dependencies needed to work."` |
| `type` | `"bool"` |

## `lanes.publish`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `false` |
| `effect` | `"Opt-in. Let worktree-write lanes with open network read gh configuration, use a git credential helper, push branches and open pull requests."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/run/provider/confinement.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Off (default) keeps publishing with the chair through host-side delivery. On gives every networked writer lane your GitHub credential, so a malicious lane can extract the token and act outside the wrapper."` |
| `type` | `"bool"` |

## `lanes.silence_seconds`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `1800` |
| `effect` | `"Mark a provider observation silent after this many seconds without output or CPU progress; never kill it for silence."` |
| `max` | `3600` |
| `min` | `1` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/run/src/launch.rs, tools/front-door/crates/supervisor/src/custody.rs, tools/front-door/crates/supervisor/src/guardian.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"Lower marks silence sooner; the process census and observation cadence stays unchanged."` |
| `type` | `"int"` |

## `routing.allow_unknown_partial_headroom`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `false` |
| `effect` | `"Allow uncalibrated partial quota headroom below the limit."` |
| `host_only` | `true` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/route.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Partial coverage cannot prove remaining allowance; exhausted lower bounds still block selection."` |
| `type` | `"bool"` |

## `routing.exclude`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `[]` |
| `effect` | `"Keep each listed provider (claude), account (label, entry or adapter/key) or exact model (adapter/id) out of named-route pools for every task. A standing list; &#96;--exclude&#96; and a graph's list are added to it, not substituted for it. A pinned &#96;--model&#96; is never affected."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/route.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Selection still weighs pacing and readiness over the remaining members, but an exclusion that empties a pool refuses the dispatch rather than widening it."` |
| `type` | `"string_list"` |

## `routing.flag_exclude`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `[]` |
| `effect` | `"The exclusion list one dispatch carries, set by &#96;--exclude&#96; on &#96;run&#96; and &#96;review&#96;. Same selectors as &#96;routing.exclude&#96;; refusals and &#96;--explain&#96; name the flag as the source."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/route.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Applies to this dispatch only; the standing &#96;routing.exclude&#96; list and a graph's list still apply."` |
| `type` | `"string_list"` |

## `routing.graph_exclude`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `[]` |
| `effect` | `"The exclusion list a graph passes to each node it launches, set from &#96;run --exclude&#96; on a preset or graph. Same selectors as &#96;routing.exclude&#96;; refusals and &#96;--explain&#96; name the graph as the source."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/route.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `strict` | `true` |
| `trade_off` | `"Applies to every node's named-route pool; a node's pinned model is never affected."` |
| `type` | `"string_list"` |

## `routing.workload`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `"general"` |
| `effect` | `"Describe the task for model policy. Read-heavy and review work give cheap-cache, million-token models a configurable preference in pools."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/crates/cli/src/run.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"A preference preserves model choice and readiness gates; it does not force every read-heavy task onto one model."` |
| `type` | `"enum"` |
| `values` | `["general", "read_heavy", "edit_heavy", "review"]` |

## `usage.project_attribution`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `default` | `false` |
| `effect` | `"Include the existing project identifier in local usage events."` |
| `reader` | `"tools/front-door/src/usage.rs"` |
| `status` | `"wired"` |
| `trade_off` | `"Off keeps project identity out of usage logs; on makes project-level usage visible to anyone who can read them."` |
| `type` | `"bool"` |

## Registry and profiles

```json
{
  "host_plan_settings": {
    "path": "domains.fabric.plan",
    "settings": {
      "auto.acceptance_items": {
        "default": "6",
        "effect": "`auto` turns planning on when the subject lists more acceptance items than this (nested sub-bullets are not counted). For big-batch unset lanes already force on, so this only changes the reason.",
        "min": 1,
        "type": "int"
      },
      "auto.batch_issues": {
        "default": "2",
        "effect": "`auto` turns planning on when one batch names at least this many distinct issues (`#N`, decimal, at most six digits). For big-batch unset lanes already force on, so this only changes the reason.",
        "min": 1,
        "type": "int"
      },
      "auto.write_crates": {
        "default": "2",
        "effect": "`auto` turns planning on when the subject's write scope touches more crates than this. For big-batch unset lanes already force on, so this only changes the reason.",
        "min": 1,
        "type": "int"
      },
      "max_nodes": {
        "default": "24",
        "effect": "Most nodes and pattern instances one plan may emit, within the host graph limits.",
        "max": 512,
        "min": 1,
        "type": "int"
      },
      "mode": {
        "allowed": "auto, on or off",
        "default": "auto",
        "effect": "Default for `provenant run --preset --plan`. on puts a principal planner node in front of the preset graph so it can shape the graph from the preset's pattern catalogue; off keeps the preset's static graph; auto stays off when the preset's shape parameter has any non-bundled origin and otherwise plans when the subject is large or its shape is unset; for big-batch unset lanes always force on, so the auto.* thresholds only change the recorded reason. `--explain` prints the decision and its reason.",
        "type": "enum"
      },
      "route": {
        "allowed": "a pool alias",
        "default": "principal",
        "effect": "Route alias the planner node runs on. When it is unavailable (undefined, excluded, exhausted or unauthenticated) the run falls back to the preset's deterministic defaults and records the reason; a weaker planner is never substituted.",
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "host_run_settings": {
    "path": "domains.run",
    "settings": {
      "grant_limit": {
        "allowed": "1 or more",
        "default": "128",
        "effect": "Maximum total plan roots and maximum entries in each provider grant family. Increase for lanes needing more roots.",
        "type": "int"
      },
      "profile_limit_bytes": {
        "allowed": "1 or more bytes",
        "default": "524288",
        "effect": "Maximum rendered macOS sandbox profile size. Increase for lanes with many grants; profiles pass through argv and may still hit OS limits.",
        "type": "int"
      },
      "projects.{project}.writer_writes": {
        "allowed": "up to 16 absolute, safe directory paths outside credential roots",
        "default": "host writer_writes",
        "effect": "Replace the host writer_writes list for this project; an empty list grants no host-configured writer roots. Origin: host configuration [domains.run.projects.<project ID>].",
        "type": "string_list"
      }
    }
  },
  "presets": {
    "balanced": {
      "description": "Today's behaviour: every knob at its registry default.",
      "knobs": {}
    },
    "economy": {
      "description": "Lower lane concurrency, accepting slower runs.",
      "knobs": {
        "lanes.max_concurrency": 4,
        "lanes.max_concurrency_read_only": 8
      }
    }
  },
  "schema_version": 1
}
```
